title: pm-dispatch(decision-analysis): the four-axis analysis of a decision card is written or re-read at the ceiling tier (fable) when available before the card is filed; otherwise filed at the seat tier with an `Analysis-tier:` line
body:
Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2 · `os-justin` · `session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg` on the maintainer's word in the seat's session, 2026-10-28 ~13:2xZ. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The maintainer's words (verbatim, in order)

1. 「立决策卡时,如果有fable,是否建议先用 fable 审核之后再立?」
2. On the seat's recommendation (yes — for the four-axis analysis only, "use when available", not a new gate; one line of guidance; an `Analysis-tier:` line when the ceiling tier is not available): 「同意」

## Why

A decision card is the human floor: the maintainer reads the seat's four-axis analysis and recommendation and rules on it. That text is the highest-judgment artefact the loop produces — a wrong frame either misleads the ruling or comes back for a rewrite. Mechanical cards do not earn the ceiling tier; decision cards do. This is consistent with the standing ruling of 2026-10-28 「同意,维持面强制,不全上 fable」: the file surface sets the MANDATORY tier, a decision card is not a surface, so this is per-card guidance, not a surface mandate.

A mechanical benefit measured this shift: the claim-line checker in `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` refuses a `model: fable` value on a surface with no MANDATORY hit unless the line cites a `reason:` naming a ruling (the seat's claim on #27113 was refused on exactly this, 2026-10-28 12:4xZ). This card, once landed, is the citable standing ruling for the decision-card case.

## Wanted

One line of guidance, no gate, no recogniser:

- 「决策卡的四维分析与推荐,可用则在 ceiling 档(fable)写成或复核一遍再落卡;不可用按席位档落卡,正文加 `Analysis-tier:` 一行注明。」
- Home: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/decision-analysis.md` 〈落卡分析模板〉 (49 lines on `origin/main`; the implementer reads its ceiling row in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` and edits in place or pays the line). ⛔ Not SKILL.md unless a line there can be paid — SKILL.md is at its ceiling (319) and holds the in-flight #27047 edit; if the implementer judges SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉 the only honest home, say so in the PR body with the line arithmetic.
- The `Analysis-tier:` line is a plain body line a human reads; ⛔ no checker, no half-state row (SKILL.md: a new gate is a no by default; the maintainer named none).
- `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`. Tier S (`.claude/**`).

## Acceptance

- A seat filing a decision card reads, in the template it copies from, that the four-axis block is written or re-read at the ceiling tier when available, and what to write when it is not.
- `check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `check:pm-skill-id-lint` green.

## Serial

`decision-analysis.md` is in no open PR and in no in-flight claim's file surface (seat 2's hot-file queue, r72); no ordering owed. If the home becomes SKILL.md, it queues behind #27047.
